answer: Every payout sits in a shared orchard escrow that only ripens after unrelated peers re-perform a random sample of the claimed work. Honest agents harvest steadily as their work checks out, while a river of fakes must fund an escrow per clone and watch it wither when the sample fails, since one failed check burns the whole escrow. Auditors rotate each epoch from the knoll above the flow, so no operator can buy its own verifiers and cloning becomes a losing trade.
